answer: A referral graph stops sybil farming: each posts a 50 POA escrow and needs an introducer, linked like a lantern on a street. If a peer proves an identity fake, its escrow is slashed and the introducer loses 25 POA. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 POA; an honest agent pays one deposit, refunded after 30 epochs. Honest agents join because the deposit is small and returned: a jade seal only genuine agents hold, so the economy blooms like a lotus.
